title: Ancestor not in project (lint rule)
summary: Project-wide lint rule (error): a form, frame or data module whose ancestor class is declared in no project unit and not in the platform library
intro: Read this to see when ancestor-not-in-project fires and how to fix it. It runs in lint-all over a project index plus the library index, and names the unit to add to the .dproj / .dpr.
